id: Bryan Adams — Bare Bones-Te Whare Whakarauika Wellington Town Hall-Wellington NZ
name: Bryan Adams — Bare Bones
venue: Te Whare Whakarauika Wellington Town Hall
long_description:
Canadian singer-songwriter Bryan Adams has one of rock’s most recognisable voices. With a career spanning four decades, he won’t be short of famous songs for his concert in Wellington’s Town Hall. This will be a specially curated show — the Bare Bones performance is one of his acclaimed acoustic series. Bryan strips back his hit songs to their essence, offering fans a rare opportunity to experience his famous catalogue in an intimate way. 

Many of Bryan’s most well-known songs will be played. You’re likely to hear chart-toppers like Summer of ‘69, (Everything I Do) I Do It For You, Heaven, Run To You, Please Forgive Me, Have You Ever Really Loved A Woman, Cuts Like A Knife, and more. 

It’s not just hits from the 80s and 90s that you’ll hear. Bryan is releasing a new album — ‘How’s It Goin’. This is a deeply personal musical love letter to his home country of Canada. It draws on country, folk and rock styles to explore a distinctly Canadian musical landscape.

id: Bat Out of Hell — The Musical-Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Bat Out of Hell — The Musical
venue: Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
The explosive stage show, Bat Out of Hell — The Musical, swoops onto the stage of Wellington’s Michael Fowler Centre in August 2027. The musical is based around songs from Meat Loaf’s 1977 album ‘Bat Out of Hell’. It marks the 50th anniversary of its release.  Featuring an all-Kiwi cast and a live band, it covers a uniquely theatrical song list from the 50-year-old album. Expect a fun, chaotic musical that defies traditional theatre rules.   

A wild, post-apocalyptic world offers a backdrop for the show. The story follows Strat, an 18-year-old rebel leader of a gang called The Lost, who falls in love with Raven, the sheltered daughter of the city's tyrannical boss, Falco. Packed with massive tunes, you will hear hits like ‘I’d Do Anything for Love (But I Won’t Do That)’, ‘Paradise by the Dashboard Light’, ‘Two Out of Three Ain't Bad’, ‘Dead Ringer for Love’, ‘It’s All Coming Back to Me Now’, and the title track.   

The Bat Out of Hell album evolved from writer and composer Jim Steinman’s early university workshops. Despite initially being rejected by mainstream radio, it became one of the biggest-selling albums in history. It’s an album that takes up space: big, brash, and loud, like the musical itself.   

Ben McDonald, the producer of the musicals Chicago and Menopause the Musical, teams up with Stewart and Tricia Macpherson (The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel and Green Day’s American Idiot musical) to produce the New Zealand tour.

id: Kāpiti Food Fair-Mazengarb Reserve Paraparaumu, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Kāpiti Food Fair
venue: Mazengarb Reserve Paraparaumu, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Grab a taste of the Kāpiti Coast with the help of 250 vendors and over 10,000 attendees. On 5 December, the Kāpiti Food Fair takes over Mazengarb Reserve in Paraparaumu. Sample big brands like Kāpiti Ice Cream and Dark Horse Coffee, meet New Zealand artisan producers, and grab a bite from a huge variety of food trucks. Better yet, choose your favourite products to take home. 

The annual event offers a great mix of food and entertainment. Relax at the main stage with a craft beer, wine, or cocktail. Enjoy live music and buskers or head to the kitchen demo stage for culinary inspiration. Kids get their own free area with games, face painting, and more. Dogs on leads are also welcome.

id: LEGO® Star Wars: The Exhibition-Tākina Wellington Convention & Exhibition Centre-Wellington NZ
name: LEGO® Star Wars: The Exhibition
long_description:
Experience the Force like never before. Thanks to LEGO® and Star Wars™, you’ll get to see iconic characters and scenes from your favourite franchise brought to life in stunning LEGO brick detail. From June 2026, Tākina in Wellington will be home to the international debut of LEGO® Star Wars™: The Exhibition.

Epic battles, gargantuan spaceships, and breathtaking landscapes from the Star Wars universe will be on display. It’s a world-first experience created by Ryan ‘Brickman’ McNaught and The Brickman team. Together, they have spent 25,000 hours and used more than 8 million LEGO bricks to create models at jaw-dropping scale. The exhibition features the largest-known collection of life-sized LEGO Star Wars™ models ever created.

name: ULTRA New Zealand
long_description: After an electrifying debut that drew more than 23,000 fans to the capital, ULTRA Music Festival is set to return to Wellington on 16 April 2027. One of the world’s most iconic electronic music brands, ULTRA has entertained millions across six continents and established itself as a must-attend event on the global festival calendar.
